subject: Editorial coverage as an Ocean.io account field
body:
Ocean.io ranks companies against a won-deal ICP from location, size, industry, technology, revenue, founding year, department size and headcount, plus hiring, funding and leadership-change signals. The category around it is already measured in the newsletter layer: Apollo in 102 articles across 88 publications, Clay in 92 across 56, ZoomInfo in 25 across 19. Ocean.io does not appear yet.

Editorial coverage is the axis missing from that model: which newsletters wrote about an account, who sponsors those lists, and whether a publication is gaining readers, computed from repeated audience snapshots rather than one scrape.

For a lookalike product the join is the whole test. I can send a sample keyed by domain so you can run it against accounts you already rank, before any integration work.
